name: binoban
summary: Enterprise CDXP infrastructure for customer data, activation, retail media, advertising, and decisioning.
description:
iOS SDK for integrating with Binoban, an enterprise CDXP infrastructure platform
for customer data, activation, retail media, advertising, governance, and
decisioning. Built for enterprise, on-premise, private, and white-label
deployment models.
